A [[Gender|female]] [[Pantoran]] '''vendor''' sold [[fruit]] in the [[central marketplace]] of a [[Pantora]]n [[city]] at the beginning of the [[Imperial Era]]. After the [[bounty hunter]] [[Fennec Shand]] tracked down her target, the child [[Cloning|clone]] [[Omega]], in the marketplace and persuaded the girl to come with her by posing as a helpful stranger, Shand learned Omega was hungry. Deliberately bumping into the vendor, who was carrying a basket of her wares, Shand knocked some of the fruit to the ground while making it look like an accident. She then stole two pieces by concealing them in her [[helmet]] as she and Omega helped gather the fallen fruit and return it to the vendor, who thanked them for their kindness.<ref name="Cornered" />
